How to use: used when importing/exporting textures, reading pixels at runtime, or converting color space; often paired with ImageCore/ImageWrapper.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "ImageWrapper" });`. Use Public when exposing `ImageWrapper` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.

Call: include its `Public/` headers to use exported types; the engine/plugin system loads the module automatically — no manual `LoadModulePtr` needed (use `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked` only for lazy loading).

cn_steps: `Imath`：它是对一个第三方库的 UBT 封装，向引擎暴露该库的功能。位于 `ThirdParty`，构建规则 `ThirdParty/Imath/Imath.Build.cs`。描述符未声明依赖。
部署：`Imath` 第三方库封装，优先依赖引擎已包好的上层模块。
怎么用：一般不要直接依赖它；优先用引擎里已封装好该库的上层模块。确需使用时把本模块加进 Build.cs，并包含其第三方头文件。
依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "Imath" });`；对外暴露 `Imath` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：不要 include 引擎模块头去用它；优先用引擎里封装该库的上层模块，仅必要时包含 ThirdParty 目录下的第三方头文件。
en_steps: `Imath`: it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine. Located under `ThirdParty`; build rule `ThirdParty/Imath/Imath.Build.cs`. The descriptor declares no dependencies.
Placement: `Imath` is a third-party library wrapper; prefer the engine module that wraps it.
How to use: usually do not depend on it directly; prefer the engine module that already wraps it. If truly needed, add it to Build.cs and include the third-party headers.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "Imath" });`. Use Public when exposing `Imath` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.
Call: do not include engine module headers to use it; use the engine module that wraps this library, and only include its ThirdParty headers when truly needed.
